title: Escaped felon prompts search after running onto freeway - NewsBreak
text:
By Alysse Dodge No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
LEMON GROVE, Calif. (FOX 5/KUSI) — The Lemon Grove Sheriff’s Substation is seeking the public’s help in locating Hiram Sanchez, a wanted felon who escaped from custody.
Sanchez was wanted on an active and outstanding felony warrant, officials said.
Sheriff’s deputies observed him in the 7100 block of Broadway in Lemon Grove around 4:00 p.m. on Thursday, Dec. 18, and placed him in handcuffs. During the arrest, Sanchez fled on foot onto State Route 94.
This placed Sanchez and the deputies in extreme danger, so they did not pursue him onto the freeway, deputies said. Sanchez slipped out of his handcuffs and continued to run away.
Despite immediate efforts to conduct a thorough search of the area, with assistance from California Highway Patrol, the San Diego Police Department’s helicopter and sheriff’s K-9 units, authorities said Sanchez was not located.
It is believed that Sanchez may be somewhere in the East County, possibly El Cajon or La Mesa, according to deputies.
Sanchez is a Hispanic male, and he is about 5’9″ tall and weighs around 160 pounds. He was last seen wearing a white hat, black shirt, black athletic pants and white shoes.
He is not considered a danger to the community, but do not approach Sanchez if you see him. Officials said call 911 or the San Diego County Crime Stoppers anonymous tip line at (888) 580-8477.
